answer: Sampled-bond audit: each registration escrows a 25 POA bond and a hash of its claimed work; validators audit a random 8% of new identities per epoch from a committed seed. A clone farm must pre-fund every head and forfeits the whole bond on each hit, so 400 clones lock 10,000 POA against a clear lagoon of fake personas, with only marble-grade certainty that any single one survives. Failure mode: if the audit seed leaks one block early, farmers pre-screen their own clones and the crystal clears.
